verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides building blocks for a custom ERP sync rather than a turnkey one. The Card Expenses API retrieves approved expenses and marks them as synced after ERP ingestion. The Bills API creates vendor invoices, and webhooks push real-time events. Spend is positioned as automating and reconciling company spend. Missing for 10: native ERP or accounting connectors, documented two-way sync of ledger or journal data, automated journal-entry posting, and independent or hands-on corroboration that sync is real-time.
